title: Tomato Jones - Episode 3
description:
It’s just a red tomato with a silly hat, trying to be a cool tomb raider by rolling and jumping all over the maps. Help him find all the treasures in the abandoned alien base, or watch him die... in many painful ways. 

Tomato Jones - Episode 3 is the exciting third installment in the fun-filled series, following Tomato Jones and Tomato Jones 2, both available on Steam.It This physics-based puzzle/adventure game combines classic RPG platformer gameplay with the skill-driven style of ball-rolling games. Your goal is to collect all coins and the hidden golden artifact at the end of each level while avoiding various dangerous traps, obstacles, and enemies.

Unlike its predecessors, this game is set in a sci-fi atmosphere, packed with humor and funny moments.

WHAT'S NEW• 30 beautiful and challenging sci-fi levels

• New dangerous traps... and DRONES!

• Mr. Jones talks to himself like a madman.

• Innovative camera movement and viewing angles that will test your nerves.

• A completely new world map and areas to explore.

• Partial controller support (but I don’t recommend it!)

• Expect to see the message "DS die count reached!" way more often.

WHAT'S OLD• Great-looking "soft body" tomato physics.

• Multiple funny hats to choose from, plus new additions.

• Fun soundtrack and SFX.

• Tons of ketchup. 

Mine carts?! Of course! ;)

Get ready to die... a lot. Tomato Jones - Episode 3 is the hardest of the three games, and I strongly recommend playing the first two as well the Tomato Jones and Tomato Jones 2.
description_short: Tomato Jones - Episode 3 is a physics-based ball-rolling platformer and the exciting third installment in the fun-filled series, following Tomato Jones and Tomato Jones 2, both already available on Steam.
